filed: 2026-11-03, before the code ran; never edited after the run
question: E75: do the D1 reads on the three SFT updates (E72's clean-model table, E74's whole-update transmission) hold on an update with a real accuracy gain?
rules: experiments/qwen_rl_reads/rules.py, run against edge cases before filing (zero denominators, NaN, inf, ties, missing reads) and against E72's and E74's stored files
updates: RL's weight changes, ~/commute-data/results-large/qwen_rl/lr1e-6w10/dW/<arm>/step_<t>.safetensors, on the 128 maths rows, 256 tokens. Leans are filed for R100 and R10. N and F are read against the same rules with no lean: file one before that job if one is wanted.

quantities.clean table: E72's T2 (qwen_fixed_masks FixedReader.clean, rules.score_t2): W0, FT, in-span part of the least-squares split, its remainder, often-on half's part, rarely-on half's part, random change at E68's matching rule (Reader.search); plus the adjoint split's weight change, no rule. Each: K = KL(FT || read), gain, top-token agreement, per-row sums
quantities.gain: (sum nll W0 - sum nll read) / (sum nll W0 - sum nll FT), next-token NLL on the rows. W0's and FT's sums from this job's clean_W0, the same numbers as E68's W0.json (reproduced on u1, u2, u3 to 2e-6 in the rule check)
quantities.share_ls: stage S: ||Delta' - Delta0||_Sigma / ||dW||_Sigma of the least-squares split, pooled over sites
quantities.tau: E74's read_group, one arm 'all': KL(masked W0 || masked W0 + dW) / KL(W0 || W0 + dW), the change an unmasked term x dW^T at its matrix, W0's masks; first 32 rows; unread if the clean KL is under 1e-5. Fixed: g. Stochastic: E74 Amendment 2's m = g + (1 - g) u and Delta share d, seed 74, one draw per row
quantities.K0: KL(W0 || masked W0) on those 32 rows, per mask kind

stops.control: first and alone, no stage S. u1 through this code: clean_W0's K, nll, ft, entropy against E72's u1/clean_W0.json; tau and K0, fixed and stochastic, against E74's u1/all.json and u1/stochastic.json (fixed tau 0.00549874, stochastic tau 0.01278859, K0 fixed 0.06708919, K0 stochastic 0.04401896, K 1.63511034). Each within 1e-3 relative; a NaN or zero reference misses. Tolerance: E74 reproduced E68's K0 sum to 9 digits across jobs, and its hook differs from the weights by about 1e-9 relative at fp32
stops.w0_same: every update: W0's own numbers (nll, entropy, K0 fixed, K0 stochastic) within 1e-3 relative of the control's. These rows and masks never see the update, so a miss means weights or components were left moved
stops.clean_FT: E72's: K of FT from FT at most 1e-3 of K of W0 from FT
stops.dW_file: sha256 against the RL run's SHA256SUMS where listed; exactly the 196 sites' shapes in fp32; ||file|| / ||W0|| at most 0.1

transmission.rule: rules.transmission, E74's rules.stochastic: tau at or over 0.25 'carries', at or under 0.05 'deaf', else 'between'; unread 'no call'. Stochastic is E74's filed read; fixed reads against the same thresholds
transmission.lean: deaf on R100 and R10, fixed and stochastic (medium)
transmission.blind_to: where the change is lost; KL is quadratic, so 0.01 is an amplitude of about 0.1; 32 rows; W0's masks only

random_vs_halves.rule: rules.random_gap: K(random) at least 10 x max(K(upper), K(lower)) 'holds', else 'misses'. 'no call' if the search did not match within its factor 1.5, K(W0) is under 1e-5, a number is unread or non-finite, or both halves are exactly 0
random_vs_halves.lean: holds on R100 and R10 (medium; ratio 15.7, 17.7, 29.6 on u1, u2, u3)
random_vs_halves.blind_to: gain; these gold rows only; random's scale is matched on KL from W0 on 16 rows, KL from FT is what it is then

inspan_vs_remainder.rule: rules.inspan_gap: K(inspan) strictly below K(remainder) 'holds', else 'misses'. 'no call' if K(W0) or both parts are under 1e-5, or a number is unread or non-finite
inspan_vs_remainder.lean: holds on R100 and R10 (medium; ratio 0.017, 0.017, 0.012 on u1, u2, u3)
inspan_vs_remainder.blind_to: gain; the parts are not additive in KL; whether a part carries the accuracy, which no read here measures

visible_difference.rule: each row of score.json carries its value, the SFT updates' range (rules.SFT) and 'inside' or 'outside' it. Outside on an R update is the result to report, whichever way the filed label falls. share_ls range 0.351 to 0.389 is read the same way, no lean
visible_difference.reported_not_leaned: E72's T2 label (rules.t2_rule through score_t2) and gains. Its label reads 'unscored' when W0's NLL minus FT's on these rows is under 0.05 nats; gain_den_nats is written beside it. GRPO trains on its own samples, not this gold text, so this denominator may be small or negative: then gain is not readable and the three rules above, on KL, still are

expected.K: at W0 it is the ruler: 1.6351 on u1, first read on R. FT and do-nothing (same weights in the clean model): 0. RL's own KL(W0 || W_t) on its held rows: 0.194 at 100, 0.064 at 10, so well above the 1e-5 floor
expected.gain: W0 0, FT and do-nothing 1, by construction
expected.agreement: W0 0.808 on u1; FT and do-nothing 1
expected.share_ls: do-nothing 1, random 0 (E72's S); u1 0.364; not part of the control, it needs stage S
expected.tau: no change: 0/0, unread. Control u1: 0.0055 fixed, 0.0128 stochastic
expected.K0: the same on every update: 0.0671 fixed, 0.0440 stochastic
